data.name: Fresh Squeezed Lemonade
data.detailed_description:
Fresh Squeezed Lemonade is a first-person business simulator about turning a simple garage lemonade stand into the neighborhood's favorite place for a cold drink—and earning enough to build the ultimate summer reward: your very own pool.

Each day, you'll decide what to make, set your prices, stock your stand, and serve as many customers as you can before closing time. When the rush is over, head into the neighborhood to gather ingredients, pickup collectibles, help your neighbors, and prepare for the next day.

Running a successful stand isn't just about squeezing lemons. Weather, ingredient costs, customer satisfaction, equipment, and your prices all affect how the day plays out. Keep things simple with reliable favorites, invest in better equipment to improve your stand, or build a bigger menu and find the strategy that works for you.

☀️ Make the Most of Every Summer

Weather affects both your customers and the ingredients available around the neighborhood. A scorching afternoon can bring plenty of thirsty customers, while a cool or rainy day might call for a different approach.

Choose between 7-day and 14-day runs, earn permanent rewards, and come back with new options and new strategies. Progress is saved after each day, so you can play a full run or enjoy the summer one day at a time.

📖 Unlock New Recipes and Upgrades

Your first menu won't be your last.

Complete milestones, help your neighbors, and grow your business to unlock new ingredients, garnishes, recipes, equipment, and upgrades. With more options available, you can start building your menu around the way you want to play.

🍋 Mix Up Your Menu

Start with the classics and gradually expand your menu with fruit punches, citrus blends, mint drinks, garnishes, and more.

Every recipe has its own ingredient costs, satisfaction bonuses, and pricing potential. A simple drink might be cheap and dependable, while a more complicated recipe can give you different ways to build satisfaction or turn a bigger profit.

💵 Set Your Own Prices

You decide what every drink costs.

Keep prices reasonable to make customers happy, or push them higher when you think the extra profit is worth it. As your neighborhood's satisfaction grows, customers become willing to pay more, opening up new strategies for your stand.

Finding the sweet spot between happy customers and healthy profits is up to you.

🛠️ Upgrade Your Equipment

A growing business needs better tools.

Use your earnings to upgrade your lemonade stand and improve the way you work. Better equipment can help you prepare drinks more efficiently, serve more customers, and handle busier days as your stand becomes more popular.

Choose which upgrades to prioritize based on your strategy. Invest in speed, capacity, convenience, or other improvements that help your stand keep up with demand.

🏡 Explore the Neighborhood

Closing the stand doesn't mean the day is over.

Walk around the neighborhood to harvest ingredients, visit shops, find collectibles, and see what's happening around town. Lemons are easy to come by, but other ingredients depend on the weather, so what you can find changes from day to day.

🤝 Help Your Neighbors

Keep an eye out for community events while you're exploring. Your neighbors might need help finding something they've lost, gathering supplies, preparing for a party, or handling another small neighborhood emergency.

Helping out can earn you money, ingredients, and even unlock entirely new recipes for your stand.

🏊 Build Your Dream Pool

Every successful day brings you closer to the biggest goal of the summer: building a pool in your backyard.

Save your earnings, grow your business, and invest in the improvements you need to reach your target. The pool is more than just a decoration—it's the reward for turning a small neighborhood stand into a thriving summer business.

How quickly you reach it depends on how you run your stand, what you sell, and how wisely you spend your money along the way.

Features

  • 🍋 Craft more than a dozen different drinks

  • 💵 Set your own prices and balance satisfaction against profit

  • 🛠️ Upgrade your equipment to serve customers more efficiently

  • 🏡 Explore a colorful low-poly neighborhood between serving sessions

  • 🌤 Adapt to changing weather and ingredient availability

  • 🤝 Complete community events and help your neighbors

  • 📖 Unlock new recipes, ingredients, garnishes, equipment, and upgrades

  • 🏊 Work toward building your own backyard pool

  • ⭐ Choose between replayable 7-day and 14-day runs

  • 🎯 Earn permanent rewards that carry into future runs

A Small Stand with Big Possibilities

Optimize every cent. Experiment with new recipes. Upgrade your equipment. Help out around the neighborhood. Save toward your pool. Or just pour some lemonade and see where the summer takes you.

Fresh Squeezed Lemonade gives you a small business, a neighborhood full of things to discover, and one big summer goal: turn your lemonade stand into a poolside success.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (4th gen) or AMD equivalent (e.g., AMD FX-series)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU (Intel HD 4000 or newer) or dedicated GPU equivalent to NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit) /
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (6th gen or newer) or AMD Ryzen 3/5 equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 560 / RX 580 (or modern integrated Vega/Radeon iGPU)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
